title: Golden Armor with Regen
description: Wearing gold armor now grants passive regeneration.
body:
# Golden Armor with Regen

Gives gold armor a purpose — wearing it now grants passive regeneration that scales with the number of pieces equipped.

## How it works

The regeneration level increases with each piece of gold armor you wear:

| Pieces worn | Effect |
|---|---|
| 1 | Regeneration I |
| 2 | Regeneration II |
| 3 | Regeneration III |
| 4 (full set) | Regeneration IV |

## Features

- Scales with the number of gold armor pieces equipped
- Effect particles are hidden for a clean experience
- Effect icon is visible in your inventory
- Efficient implementation — only refreshes when < 30 ticks remain or the level changes

## Installation

1. Install [Minecraft Forge](https://files.minecraftforge.net/) for 1.12.2, 1.20.1
2. Download the latest `.jar` from the Versions tab
3. Place it in your `mods/` folder
4. Launch the game and enjoy!

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.12.2, 1.20.1
- Forge
